intermediate.title: Red Bull KM Sprint | Bernalda (100.4 km)

story: Early in the stage, three Italians went on the attack. With 12 kilometres remaining, the last two escapees were caught. Many sprinters struggled to keep up with the high pace set by UAE over the hills in southern Italy. Vacek controlled the tempo in the final kilometre for his teammate Pedersen, who narrowly won the sprint ahead of Zambanini.
